acceptanceCriteria: The per-test wall time of ./internal/doccorpus is measured on a quiet host and under load, and the slowest tests (TestBehaviorAcceptanceAmendment first) are named with their cost drivers.
The package finishes well inside the 30m per-package timeout (decision 0082) under the load the umbrella records, through shared fixtures, caching or splitting, without dropping assertions.
Before and after timings are retained in a build-log entry.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator from the V1-0985 lane.

Observed: on branch claude/v1-0985-behavior-provider-neutral-member (base 0b5096ca, Go 1.27.1, Darwin 25.6.0, about 15 concurrent go test runs, load ~55 on 12 CPUs), `go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/doccorpus` timed out during TestBehaviorAcceptanceAmendment with no failure before it. A rerun with -v -timeout 60m passed in 2093s (82 tests).

Expected: the package fits the 30m hang detector with margin. Actual: about 35 minutes under load. Related: V1-0643 (hermetic git fixtures for doccorpus), the test reliability umbrella. Not yet measured on a quiet host.
